facts.text: Manhattanville University's Valiant Fast Track program is the only one in Westchester County, and one of few in New York State, offering students the opportunity to earn a full 120-credit bachelor's degree in three years.

sources.title: Valiant Fast Track: 3 Year Bachelor's Degree
sources.quote: This new program is one of the few in New York State, and the only one in Westchester County, offering students the opportunity to earn a full 120-credit bachelor's degree in just three years.
